ui.board.dropHere: Drop files to add them to this project
ui.board.emptyBody: Drop pictures, clips, voice or music here, then plan the first film with Claude in the chat.
ui.board.helloNoStyle: Hi. Pick a style above (or tap a suggestion), then tell me what the film should be. I'll ask about anything unclear before we make it.
ui.board.hint: Pick references with +, then plan the next film in the chat
ui.board.pickHint: The first one you pick leads; the others are blended in.
ui.board.placeholder: Describe film {n}: what happens, who's in it, the mood…
ui.board.planFirst: Plan it in a chat first →
ui.board.promptLabel: What the next film should be
ui.board.tooShort: Write a little more about the film (10 characters at least).
ui.film.askHead: Claude is asking — work continues once you answer
ui.film.chatIdle: Send a message to keep working on this video
ui.film.chatLive: The video is being made (no need to press the button again). Claude's work is shown live here.
ui.film.dropHere: Drop files here to send them to Claude
ui.film.estimateHint: The percentage is an estimate based on the step Claude is on. A video usually takes 10–20 minutes.
ui.film.failedNote: The video isn't out yet. See what happened in the chat on the right — reply there and work will continue.
ui.film.headFailed: Stopped — reply in the chat to continue
ui.film.phLive: Send Claude a note… (read before the next step)
ui.film.phSucceeded: Say what you'd like changed… (sending starts the edit)
ui.lang.label: Language
ui.nav.label: Studio
ui.new.attachTitle: Attach files (you can also drag or paste them)
ui.new.flowBody: Claude opens Flow in your Chrome and makes the images it needs. Keep Chrome open while the video is being made. This uses a few Flow credits.
ui.new.flowTitle: ✦ Images are made automatically with Google Flow AI.
ui.new.hello: Hi. Tell me in plain words what video you'd like in the {style} style. If anything is unclear, I'll ask.
ui.new.makeRest: Let Claude decide the rest and make it
ui.new.maxFiles: You can attach up to {max} files.
ui.new.ncAfter: use. For client or business work you need a commercial licence (onetake Pro).
ui.new.ncBefore: This style is free only for
ui.new.noGen: This style needs AI-made images, and no image generator is turned on for this server, so it can't make videos yet.
ui.new.pickLeft: Pick a style from the list.
ui.new.placeholder: Write what you want… drag or paste images and files here
ui.new.planDraft: Draft plan (the brief Claude will send)
ui.new.planReady: ✓ Video plan (the brief Claude will send)
ui.new.samples: Examples: tap one to send it
ui.new.styleBeforeFiles: Pick a style before adding files.
ui.new.tellFirst: Tell Claude what you want first.
ui.projects.bibleEmpty: Claude will write here after the first episode.
ui.projects.bibleHint: Claude's notes on characters, places and style, read and updated every episode
ui.projects.descPlaceholder: Characters, world, style… Claude reads this for every episode
ui.projects.emptyBody: A project is a folder. Keep a series of episodes together and Claude reuses the characters, places, style and music.
ui.projects.noEpisodesBody: The first episode sets the characters, places and style. Later episodes reuse them.
ui.projects.title: My projects
ui.src.canSource: Fine if you don't have any. Claude will look up publicly available information itself.
